19:05 Local Time, 18:05 GMT, 23:35 IST: Rashid spins Afghanistan to victory as they go 1-0 up in the series. His brilliance made all the difference in a chase that was within sight for Ireland after the start they got. They were 96/1 after just 14 overs thanks to a maiden ODI fifty from Cade Carmichael. But Rashid came on and changed the game with a couple of quick wickets early on, removing Balbirnie and Tector. The quicks then made a couple of inroads through the middle before Rashid came back and took a bunch of wickets to wrap it all up. No surprise he's Player of the Match.

Rahmat Shah | Afghanistan captain: Our top order played really well. Assessed the conditions early, that's why we made 300 runs. We missed 20-30 runs. Target would've been 330 had we not lost wickets in the middle. There was a wind blowing to one side. Used the fast bowlers against the wind. And spinner using the wind side. Rashid bowled really well. We are very lucky to have a bowler like Rashid. Fast bowlers, spinners, we gave the plan and they executed the plan really well. That's why the result.
That's all we have from this one. Until next time, it's goodbye!
